coreMemory.english: n. the reason why something is done
coreMemory.structure: main purpose /meɪn ˈpɜːrpəs/（主要目的）；purpose of doing /ˈpɜːrpəs ʌv duɪŋ/（做……的目的）；serve a purpose /sɝv ə ˈpɜːrpəs/（起作用；有用途）；on purpose /ɑn ˈpɜːrpəs/（故意地）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ use purpose with the same article in every context → ✅ check the countability of purpose in context；❌ translate purpose word by word → ✅ learn the complete phrase “main purpose”

commonErrors.wrong: use purpose with the same article in every context
commonErrors.wrongPhonetic: /jus ˈpɜːrpəs wɪð ðə seɪm ɑrtəkəl ɪn ɛvɚi kɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.right: check the countability of purpose in context
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /tʃɛk ðə countability ʌv ˈpɜːrpəs ɪn kɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.note: 同一个名词在不同义项下可能有可数、不可数或单复数差异，不能机械套用冠词。
不要只按中文逐字替换；优先把本卡高频搭配作为完整句块记忆。
